components.title: CNCF Source Repository

components.purpose: Define compliance rules for CNCF source repositories.

props.value: Branch Protection Rules: Branch protection rules are used

props.value: Supply Chain Security Best Practices: Supply chain security best practices are adhered to

props.name: Rule_Description

components.title: privateer-native
components.description: Checks provided by Privateer (pvtr) itself: its github-repo plugin evaluates the OpenSSF Open Source Project Security Baseline (OSPS) for a GitHub repository. Each control has its own OSPS requirement.
components.purpose: Validate CNCF controls using OSPS Baseline requirement results from Privateer.

components.title: privateer-plugins
components.description: Checks provided by the cncf-controls Privateer plugin written for this project (privateer-plugins/cncf-controls), which evaluates the five CNCF controls the OSPS Baseline does not cover. It runs alongside github-repo in the same pvtr run.
components.purpose: Validate five CNCF controls using requirement results from the cncf-controls plugin.

components.title: not-checked
components.description: Controls that are in scope for git repositories but have no Privateer check, native or plugin (no-check). They are reported as not determined and never count as a pass. The reason for each is in docs/privateer-check-coverage.md.
components.purpose: Record in-scope controls that are not yet automatically assessed.

components.title: kcp-dev/kcp
components.purpose: CNCF project source repository assessed against the cncf-repo profile.

control-implementation.description: Implementation of cncf-repo profile controls. Parameter values are specific to this repository.
